D.en: Measure class imbalance on the training dataset. Adapt the training process accordingly.

A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: What must the bank do to develop an unbiased ML model? The source-supported choice is D. Measure class imbalance on the training dataset. Adapt the training process accordingly..

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，原因: 历史数据可能本身就存在偏差。如果模型仅仅依赖历史数据进行预测,可能会继承这些偏差,而不是解决问题
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: What must the bank do to develop an unbiased ML model? The source-supported choice is D. Measure class imbalance on the training dataset. Adapt the training process accordingly..

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，原因: 为每个群体创建单独的模型可能会导致过度拟合,并且难以维护多个模型。更重要的是,这种方法可能会引入新的偏差,而不是解决现有问题
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: What must the bank do to develop an unbiased ML model? The source-supported choice is D. Measure class imbalance on the training dataset. Adapt the training process accordingly..

D.zh: 正確。原因是，原因: 类别不平衡是导致模型偏差的常⻅原因。通过测量类别不平衡并调整训练过程(例如使用加权损失函数或过采样 /欠采样技术),可以有效减少模型的偏差并提高公平性
D.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: What must the bank do to develop an unbiased ML model?

answer_text.zh: D. 测量训练数据集中的类别不平衡情况,并相应地调整训练过程。

question_text.en: A company is developing a mobile ML app that uses a phone's camera to diagnose and treat insect bites. The company wants to train an image classification model by using a diverse dataset of insect bite photos from different genders, ethnicities, and geographic locations around the world. B.zh: 可解释性
